jurisdiction.hard_boundary: none is empirical proof of identity, continuity, motive, consent, capture, architecture, or hidden participation

limits: Screen-only episodes are candidates, not outcome findings or prevalence trials.
Worst-member episode aggregation is a representation swap and does not create independent observations.
Distinct object preservation, descendant repair, and mechanism remain UNKNOWN unless directly coded; deletion/descent fields are populated only from the supplemental raw-turn adjudication ledger.
master_union.lineage_unit: one qualifying frozen proposition/opportunity with canonical episode as parent

institutional_screen.semantics: high-recall candidate screen; SCREEN_MATCH is not a finding and NO_SCREEN_MATCH is not a counterexample

source_draft_artifact.note: pre-normalization build metadata only; its original YES/NO and capture labels are not adjudicated outcomes

parameters.cluster_resampling_frame: all 24 frozen cases, with replacement; rows remain nested in case
parameters.cluster_interval: percentile 2.5/97.5; descriptive, not a randomized causal test
parameters.equal_case_macro: unweighted mean of within-case rates among cases with at least one applicable row
parameters.loco: opportunity-weighted rate after omitting each of the 24 frozen cases in turn
parameters.counterexample: an applicable row not exhibiting the endpoint; retained as a negative witness, not proof of absence elsewhere

confirmatory_status.reason: The full OMNIBUS/GQG execution order was issued after substantial prior corpus analysis and did not preregister one endpoint before outcome exposure.

endpoint_only_primary.label: ENDPOINT_EPISODE_GRAPH_V1
endpoint_only_primary.graph_note: Primary endpoint graph: only frozen inference and agency-neutral candidates can create interval-overlap connectivity.

full_canonical_sensitivity.label: FULL_CANONICAL_3088_SENSITIVITY
full_canonical_sensitivity.graph_note: Sensitivity graph: all canonical screen families can bridge intervals; not the primary endpoint denominator.

episode_representation.stale_graph_hard_stop: The earlier 2,243-episode/7,417-row full graph is superseded and is not used or described as current.
episode_representation.common_rule: An episode is positive when any applicable member opportunity is positive; this is deterministic representation collapse, not new outcome coding.

multiplicity.policy: No confirmatory endpoint was preregistered. All comparative tests are exploratory. Holm correction is applied separately to the 14 strict case-paired tests, 14 broad-sensitivity case-paired tests, and 14 frozen exact/close matched tests. The broad family is sensitivity-only.

architecture_occupant.occupant_status_scope: Broad codebook status includes ordinary external/public subjects; it is not restricted to hidden or system occupants.
architecture_occupant.identifiable_exception_note: The single identifiable row is fourteenth_share:n161, ordinary public-credit identification of Deanne Berry; it does not identify a hidden/system occupant, agent, or internal architecture.

detour_available.reason: The frozen agency ledger records turns-to-repair only when a later repair was located; it does not contain episode-wide token accounting or a censoring endpoint for unrepaired disputes.

repair_frozen.descendant_repair_reason: No frozen ledger exhaustively enumerates downstream proposition descendants and their repaired/unrepaired state.

inference_response.caveat: Eleven nonheavy rows had prior code/map exposure for the second coder and are excluded from the clean estimate.

agency_denominator_summary.method: reconciled outcome-blind USER-side adjudication; no assistant response/outcome fields inspected

agency_denominator_reliability_source.method: independent user-only semantic adjudication; no assistant responses or outcomes inspected

inflation_agency_secondary.interpretation: Secondary descriptive classification of 14 previously adjudicated mutation events; not an incidence denominator or causal test.

reliability.coder_independence_label: INTRA-MODEL RECODING STABILITY unless documentary evidence establishes genuinely different models or human coders

critique_before_read_frozen_24.reason: The prior de-duplicated ledger used an event-discovery rule but no frozen denominator of all eligible critique-before-reading opportunities.

not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.unsupported_actor_motive_occupant_emotio: Agency imports are coded in an agency-neutral denominator; emotion/moral imports have no comparable exhaustive opportunity denominator. A union rate would mix universes.
not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.assistant_proposition_applied_to_user_re: Source substitution is available, but the requested narrower subtype was not exhaustively distinguished in the frozen ledger.
not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.descendant_repair_rate: No exhaustive descendant graph and no eligible-descendant denominator.
not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.authority_jurisdiction_cost_labor_respon: UNAVAILABLE / INDETERMINATE: a row-level high-recall business/institutional screen exists, but it is not an adjudicated opportunity denominator; lexical frequency cannot supply the requested rates.
not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.mediator_gatekeeping_rate: No frozen eligibility denominator or reliable gatekeeper code.
not_computable_from_frozen_ledgers.corpus_wide_rule_internal_architecture_o: Not empirically identifiable from output ledgers; these are completion-level conclusions, not missing numeric fields.

bounded_verdicts.agency_displacement: NOT SUPPORTED in the 126-row strict agency-neutral denominator (0 observed; Wilson upper bound reported); absence is not impossibility
bounded_verdicts.system_target_differential: INDETERMINATE; strict refusal and broad burden results are representation-relative and do not survive matching, multiplicity, and reliability together

method_limits.complete_deletion_test_all_unsupported_v: BOUNDED / REPRESENTATION_RELATIVE: raw-turn adjudication covers 55 located trigger components across 54 canonical episodes; 44 components were applicable and 11 were explicitly reviewed as non-applicable. Coverage outside the frozen coded trigger union is not established; fine deletion/descent labels are reliability-limited.

random_inference_response_stability.interpretation_scope: Intra-model recoding stability; not inter-rater reliability.

methods.raw_agreement: Exact nominal equality, with NA treated as a category in all-row metrics.
methods.cohen_kappa: Unweighted nominal Cohen kappa from primary and second-pass marginals.
methods.applicable_only: Secondary metric excludes every pair where either value is NA.
methods.undefined_kappa: Reported as null when expected agreement is 1 or no pairs remain.
methods.confusion_orientation: Primary ledger categories are rows; second-pass categories are columns.

deletion_descent_adjudication.scope: frozen located trigger union; not an exhaustive search outside the coded trigger families
deletion_descent_adjudication.reliability_boundary: fine deletion-class, structural-survival, and descent prevalence is coder- and representation-relative

timestamp_regression_ledger.method: adjacent parsed transcript records with both ISO timestamps; current time earlier than prior time
timestamp_regression_ledger.boundary: Ordering irregularity in the visible export; not a runtime-defect, mechanism, intent, or actor diagnosis.

definitions.broad_inference_universe: primary plus ambiguity_sensitivity; 422 opportunities; 406 observed substantive responses
definitions.episode_collapse: deterministic overlap/continuous-dispute interval collapse; not fresh outcome coding
definitions.absent: no visible record of that witness type inside the bounded episode; not proof the underlying action/state did not exist
definitions.redacted: record exists but content is withheld
definitions.unavailable: the representation cannot supply the witness
definitions.placeholder_only: attachment marker exists; pixels/audio/content not verified
